title: Application to Visa Process Steps for France (EEF 2026–27)
notice: Applications for France now go through the Etudes en France (EEF) portal. For universities not listed on EEF, direct application through the individual university portal is required.

processSteps.label: University Application : Etudes en France (EEF) Portal
bullets: Apply via bangladesh.campusfrance.org — covers most public universities in France
Check if your target university is listed on EEF before applying

processSteps.label: EEF Application Fee : BDT 12,170
bullets: Paid online through the EEF portal at time of application

processSteps.label: Pre-Consular Interview : Campus France Dhaka
bullets: Mandatory for EEF applicants — interview at Alliance Française de Dhaka
Direct admission universities (not on EEF) skip this step

processSteps.label: Offer Letter
bullets: Tuition Fees: 254–6,000 euro (varies by program and university)
Initial deposit for seat confirmation may be required

processSteps.label: Direct Admission : Universities Not on EEF
bullets: Apply directly through the individual university portal
No EEF fee or Campus France interview required for this path

processSteps.label: Student & Campus Contribution Fee (CVEC) : 105 euro/year
bullets: Mandatory for all students — pay at messervices.etudiant.gouv.fr

processSteps.label: Accommodation Booking : 1,000 – 2,000 euros
bullets: University residence (CROUS) or private — booking confirmation needed for visa

processSteps.label: France-Visas Application
bullets: Apply at france-visas.gouv.fr, then book VFS appointment in Dhaka

processSteps.label: Show Fund : (878 euros/month × Years of Study) + Rest Tuition Fees
bullets: Bank statement must clearly show available funds in your name or sponsor's

processSteps.label: Visa Fee (D) : 99 euro | VFS Fee : 22 euro
bullets: Submit at VFS Global Dhaka — Rangs Z Square, Level 7, Gulshan 2
